_README: Key   = the file as it exists in the source folder.
name  = the filename it gets in the output folder (no extension).
note  = what it looks like, for your reference. Not used by the script.
sure  = true when the name is backed by evidence, false when it is my
read of three sample frames. Fix any `false` before uploading -
a wrong client name on a portfolio piece is worse than a vague one.
Names are lowercase with hyphens and no spaces, parentheses or
apostrophes, because these become public Google Cloud Storage URLs and
anything else has to be percent-encoded.
Edit freely, then re-run with --force to rebuild.
